entries.title: Ask HN: I made $24k over the last month. Now what?
entries.author: maxklein
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I made $24k over the last month. Now what?
entries.excerpt: I sell apps on the app store. A lot of small cheap apps. Revenue is hitting $1000 per day on the weekends (Here is the graph: http://imgur.com/T0z5p.png). But I'm facing another problem. I don't know what to do with the money, how to use this very large monthly income to actually make myself rich. entries.title: Tell HN: Why you should submit your stuff as a blog posting
entries.author: jacquesm
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Why you should submit your stuff as a blog posting
entries.excerpt: Self posts are strongly discounted on HN, if you post a question or an article without a link then you will find that there is a good chance that you will not be getting any traction at all. The reason for this is that self posts are discounted at (and this is a guess, maybe PG can correct me) roughly 40% of what it would take to get a similar frontpage ranking for a regular post. entries.guide_zh: 作者认为纯文字帖在 HN 获得曝光较难，建议把内容写成博客再投稿。
